the_rate_this_establishes: three verb implementations produced five additional successes on a 40-task sample: roughly 1.7 reach points per verb. This is the first quantitative estimate of the return on implementing a verb, and it turns 'make more verbs work' from a slogan into a project plan.

what_is_still_refused_and_why.reason: requires counting a rendered polygon - visual, not textual
operand is the glyph x; the control is a DIV labelled Close

the_arithmetic_of_the_remaining_gap: 8 refusals + 21 attempts that failed = 29 of 40 not passing even though 32 were attempted. Coverage is now the smaller problem (80%); competence within a verb is the larger one (11/32 = 34%). The project plan is therefore: implement remaining verbs (about 1.7 points each) and deepen the competence of the verbs that already parse.
what_is_NOT_claimed: that one episode per task is a reliable estimate
